summary: Preserve native governance during explicit scaffold adoption

delivery.outcome: Publish a guarded explicit scaffold adopter that preserves native governance manifests and immutable adoption locks, with real regression tests.
nonGoals: No changes to existing adopter repositories or controller policy
No legacy worktree repair or foreign scope takeover

architecture.decision: Reject legacy scaffold replacement before any writes when native governance or an immutable adoption lock is present; retain additive auto registration and explicit replacement of legacy scaffolds.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded adopter guard without modifying target repositories.

validation.evidence: Native manifest, locked and partial adoption inputs remain byte-identical; legacy explicit replacement and additive registration remain supported.
Full suite and native governance pass before independent exact-head publication.
